title: Flaws in the LLM Automation Narrative
summary: George Perrett, Javae Elliott, Jennifer Hill, Marc Scott. Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly described as performing at the level of human experts on knowledge economy tasks. These claims are primarily based on how LLMs perform on benchmarking tasks that measure average performance across standardized datasets.
